bounded_static_path.submission: A generic writeData<int> storage method forwards an InputControlEvent vector to an event helper.
bounded_static_path.first_consumer: The helper conditionally forwards matching entries to its first per-event consumer.
bounded_static_path.template_type_meaning: The int template parameter identifies the storage/sample-buffer type; it is not an identity for selected F06ND Category5.
bounded_static_path.event_identity: The event-vector producer, owner, and generation are not joined to the selected category5 source.
